title: example for currentRefinedValues doesn't have any refinements to remove
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**

bug (docs)

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

the widget is just shown, but not useful since there are no refinements

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

have some widgets shown so users can see what currentRefinedValues does

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**
